none: PAS NLM-7A4001: Roman Coin: Commemorative Radiate of Claudius II from Kirmington
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate. Commemorative issue for Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [DIVO CLAVDIO]. Reverse description: Eagle standing right. Reverse inscription: CONS[ECRATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.1mm, Weight: 3.11gms, die axis: 6
